title: Projectional continuous data assimilation on the torus: Resonant and kernel-free regimes
summary: We study continuous data assimilation for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations on the periodic torus using a single signed scalar velocity projection in a prescribed spatially varying direction. We prove exponential synchronization in both L2 and H1 through two complementary mechanisms. In the regular resonant regime, nontrivial invisible currents are controlled through a moving-frame expansion, adapted coordinates, and Farhat-Lunasin-Titi logarithmic estimates, provided the resulting geometric shear defect is viscously absorbable.
